content: We need number of C=O groups in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is implicit? We need to get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons? But we don't know molecule. Maybe the system expects to call a tool that returns data for the sample at hand (the environment has a sample). Use ir_spectra to detect C=O stretch. Or carbon_nmr_spectra to see carbonyl carbon shifts (~190-220 ppm). The cheapest is IR because carbonyl stretch is distinctive. Use ir_spectra tool.
